title: Google launches five free AI tools to cut software costs for #GoogleAI #AITools #TechInnovation
description: Google released five free AI tools designed to help creators and small teams reduce software costs. These include Pomelli for social-media strategy, Opal for AI workflows, Mixboard for AI image remixing, Stitch for app interface design, and Antigravity for AI coding assistance. Each tool streamlines early-stage research, design, and prototyping, making it easier to experiment without investing in multiple separate applications. While outputs require review and data privacy protection, the suite offers an efficient solution for simple projects and fast iteration. By integrating AI across strategy, design, and development, these tools reflect ongoing innovation in AI-driven productivity and creative workflows, enabling smaller teams to compete with larger enterprises. #GoogleAI #Pomelli #OpalAI #Mixboard #StitchAI #AntigravityAI #AItools #AIDesign #AICoding #CreativeAI #SmallTeamTech #AIProductivity #PrototypingTools #AIWorkflow #TechInnovation
